subject: general
question: Angela Merkel who recently won UN refugee prize is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Former German Chancellor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Angela Merkel** is the former **German Chancellor, **which means she was the** head of the German government** from **2005 to 2021.**
 
• She won the** United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) prize** in **2021** for her outstanding leadership and efforts in helping refugees and migrants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **UN High Commissioner for Refugees** is a separate position in the United Nations responsible for **protecting and supporting refugees **around the world.

 
 
• This position is currently held by** Filippo Grandi.**
 
 
 
• **The Secretary-General of the United Nations** is the head of the UN Secretariat and responsible for **overseeing the work of the UN **and its agencies.
 
 
• The current Secretary-General is **Antundefinednio Guterres.**
 
 
 
• The **President of Ukraine **is the head of state of Ukraine and responsible for representing the country domestically and internationally.
 
 
• The current President is **Volodymyr Zelensky.**
